Name: Mila's Traveling merchant Cart and Boat
Author: Stavetskaya
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f4cccc][center][size=4]This is a simple replacer for a traveling merchant pig with a beautiful doe created by [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/142361808]StarAmy[/url] 
[size=4]with a cart and a boat created by me!
I use her [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16673]Enchanted Traveling Cart[/url][size=4] as a template for my own with her permission and encouraging. [/size]


[size=5]Mods on a screenshots: [/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1213]Natural Color Reshade[/url]

[size=4]Foliage Redone Reshade (grass and soil) from [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9139916]DustBeauty[/url][url=https://blog.naver.com/codnjsdl8235/222314151470]
[/url][size=4](Not available on nexus)[/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16842]Mila's Foliage[/url][size=4] (All visible foliage in screenshots)[/size]

[url=https://blog.naver.com/codnjsdl8235/222314151470]GH Peach Body Type[/url][size=4] for farmer body[/size]

[size=4]Hairstyle - my own custom mod, not released yet.[/size]

[size=4]Clothing - vanilla and closed distributions from Naver Cafe.[/size]


[size=3]Thank YOU for reading and attention!
(Please, if you like it don't forget to endorse. For me it's quite important)
Enjoy your game!

[img]https://c.tenor.com/V07mRV2tHE0AAAAM/little-twin-stars-kiki.gif[/img][/size][/center][/color][/font]
